Mira: FYI — KiteWorks renewal in 30d. Usage down ~70% over last 6w (avg daily API calls 4k -> 1.2k). Procurement running an RFP; new ML lead (Jordan) joined last week. Thinking we need a small remediation plan: immediate triage, targeted enablement, propose 6-week pilot extension. Any objections?

Devon: thanks Mira. Do we know root cause? model latency/regressions? or just adoption drop?

Mira: quick check: latency stable, error rate flat. Most drop from two teams: DataOps stopped scheduled jobs (they said cost concerns) + Search team paused experiments. Have screenshot of usage heatmap: https://redwood.internal/kiteworks/heatmap

Raj: can offer 2-hr workshop + migration guide to batching/KV-cache to cut cost. Also can propose Dedicated discount for pilot. I'll draft a technical scope.

Mira: @Raj please draft and ping Jordan + procurement. @Devon want to own commercial ask (pilot pricing + SLA). I'll set sync with their ML lead. Target: get decision in 10 days.

Devon: on it. I'll prepare 2 pricing options: 6-week pilot w/ usage-based cap & canary rollback, or 3-month commitment w/ concession. Will share by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled with KiteWorks: Thu 2024-07-18 14:00 PDT — calendar invite sent to Mira, Devon, Raj, Jordan (KiteWorks).

Mira: thx. Also capture feedback: they flagged docs on embedding limits + lack of a batching recipe. Raj can we add a short README + sample notebook?

Raj: yes, will add notebook + quickstart in repo, and attach to customer email.

Devon: next steps summarized: 1) Raj: technical scope + notebook (48h) 2) Devon: pricing options (24h) 3) Mira: customer sync + stakeholder map (tomorrow). I'll follow up on procurement contact (Sofia).

Mira: noted. assign owners in Gainsight after this thread. :thumbsup:
